description:
Estimate the time constant, gain and dead time of a first-order model from a recorded step
        response you supply, with how well it fits. Feed the result to compose_digital_twin.
        Example: fit_first_order_model(samples=[{"timestamp_s": 0, "value": 20, "quality": "good"}, {"timestamp_s": 10, "value": 31, "quality": "good"}, ...], input_step=10).

input_step.description: Size of the input step that produced the response.
input_step.title: Input Step

samples.description: Step response rows you supply, each {"timestamp_s": seconds, "value": number, "quality": "good"}, oldest first.
samples.title: Samples

name: fit_first_order_model
title: Fit a first-order model to a step response
